V2E attempt 1: ACCEPTED. Reviewer: external (operator relay).
The pre-registration (prereg-v2, freeze 1a853f4, pushed 2026-10-14 12:21 UTC),
the 10-hour run, the frozen analysis and its verification are accepted. H0 is
confirmed on T1a in all three families at the minimum attainable Holm p (0.008)
and replicates descriptively on T1b. H1 and H2 are correctly reported as
insufficient. The calibrated game, lab, share outputs and README are accepted
as a base. Conditions for V2F:
G1 N-SIGN shifts per-target in-strength (KS about 0.25). A null that also
   preserves binned excitatory and inhibitory strength (N-STRENGTH) is needed.
G2 T1a is extracted by hop distance from ports, which may favor convergent,
   feedforward structure that shuffles destroy. H0 must be tested on T2 and on
   the full 166,700-neuron graph.
G3 Mechanism and assumption checks (spectral and cycle structure, sign model,
   noise level) are needed as exploratory analyses.
G4 The game's scramble runs at the game coupling s = 0.01, below where H0 shows
   saturation (about 0.02 to 0.03), so players cannot see the finding. Add a
   coupling lab. WebKit rendering (40 to 47 fps) must improve.
G5 README reads as an internal report; it needs a public structure.
G6 Software license: MIT for code (operator decision); MaleCNS data stays CC-BY.
G7 CONTINUE.md must not remain at repo root when no run is in progress.
